```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(shiny)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

options(width = 100)
terraOptions(progress = 0)

orthomosaic_path <- "data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif"
plots_path <- "data/plot_boundaries.geojson"

if (!file.exists(orthomosaic_path)) stop("Missing data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif")
if (!file.exists(plots_path)) stop("Missing data/plot_boundaries.geojson")

rgb_raw <- terra::rast(orthomosaic_path)
plots_raw <- terra::vect(plots_path)

if (terra::nlyr(rgb_raw) < 3) stop("The RGB orthomosaic must contain at least three bands.")

rgb_raw <- rgb_raw[[1:3]]
names(rgb_raw) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

plot_id_candidates <- c("plot_id", "Plot_ID", "plot", "Plot", "id", "ID")
plot_id_matches <- plot_id_candidates[plot_id_candidates %in% names(plots_raw)]
if (length(plot_id_matches) == 0) {
  plots_raw$plot_id <- paste0("Plot_", seq_len(nrow(plots_raw)))
  plot_id_field <- "plot_id"
} else {
  plot_id_field <- plot_id_matches[[1]]
}

safe_gli <- function(red, green, blue) {
  denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue
  terra::ifel(denominator == 0, NA, (2 * green - red - blue) / denominator)
}

calculate_otsu_threshold <- function(raster, sample_size = 100000, bins = 256) {
  sampled <- terra::spatSample(
    raster,
    size = min(sample_size, terra::ncell(raster)),
    method = "regular",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    values = TRUE
  )
  values <- as.numeric(sampled[, 1])
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) < 2) stop("Not enough valid GLI values for Otsu thresholding.")

  h <- hist(values, breaks = bins, plot = FALSE)
  p <- h$counts / sum(h$counts)
  omega <- cumsum(p)
  mu <- cumsum(p * h$mids)
  mu_total <- sum(p * h$mids)
  variance <- (mu_total * omega - mu)^2 / (omega * (1 - omega))
  variance[!is.finite(variance)] <- NA_real_
  h$mids[which.max(variance)]
}

align_plots <- function(raster, polygons) {
  if (!terra::same.crs(raster, polygons)) {
    polygons <- terra::project(polygons, terra::crs(raster))
  }
  polygons
}
```

## Welcome

This tutorial keeps the guided `learnr` interface, Shiny controls, Plotly charts, and one interactive Leaflet **vector** map. Raster data are never sent to Leaflet. RGB bands, RGB composites, GLI, and masks are displayed only with standard `terra` plots.

### Learning objectives

1. Inspect an RGB orthomosaic.
2. Name Red, Green, and Blue bands.
3. Calculate the Green Leaf Index (GLI).
4. Apply Otsu thresholding.
5. Create a vegetation mask.
6. Mask RGB and GLI layers.
7. Explore plot polygons in a vector-only Leaflet map.
8. Extract plot-level mean GLI, GLI variability, and canopy cover.
9. Download the plot-level trait table.

> The expected band order is Red, Green, Blue.

---

## Activity 1: Inspect the RGB orthomosaic

```{r inspect-raster, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw

print(rgb)
terra::nlyr(rgb)
terra::res(rgb)
terra::ext(rgb)
terra::crs(rgb)
```

---

## Activity 2: Name and compare RGB bands

```{r compare-bands, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
names(rgb) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(rgb[["Red"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Reds"), main = "Red band")
plot(rgb[["Green"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Greens"), main = "Green band")
plot(rgb[["Blue"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Blues"), main = "Blue band")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Activity 3: Display the RGB composite

```{r rgb-composite, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw

terra::plotRGB(
  rgb,
  r = 1,
  g = 2,
  b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "RGB True-Color Orthomosaic"
)
```

---

## Activity 4: Calculate GLI

\[
GLI = \frac{2Green - Red - Blue}{2Green + Red + Blue}
\]

```{r calculate-gli, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
red <- rgb[["Red"]]
green <- rgb[["Green"]]
blue <- rgb[["Blue"]]

denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue

gli <- terra::ifel(
  denominator == 0,
  NA,
  (2 * green - red - blue) / denominator
)

names(gli) <- "GLI"

plot(gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "RdYlGn"), main = "Green Leaf Index")
terra::global(gli, c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)
```

### Interactive GLI histogram

```{r gli-histogram-ui, echo=FALSE}
plotlyOutput("gli_histogram", height = "380px")
```

```{r gli-histogram-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
analysis_objects <- reactive({
  gli <- safe_gli(rgb_raw[["Red"]], rgb_raw[["Green"]], rgb_raw[["Blue"]])
  names(gli) <- "GLI"
  threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
  mask <- terra::ifel(gli > threshold, 1, 0)
  names(mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"
  vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(mask == 1, gli, NA)
  names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"
  plots <- align_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)
  list(gli = gli, threshold = threshold, mask = mask, vegetation_gli = vegetation_gli, plots = plots)
})

output$gli_histogram <- renderPlotly({
  values <- terra::values(analysis_objects()$gli, mat = FALSE)
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  threshold <- analysis_objects()$threshold

  plotly::plot_ly(
    x = values,
    type = "histogram",
    nbinsx = 80,
    name = "GLI"
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = paste("GLI Distribution; Otsu Threshold =", round(threshold, 4)),
      xaxis = list(title = "GLI"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Pixel count"),
      shapes = list(list(
        type = "line", x0 = threshold, x1 = threshold,
        y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
        line = list(color = "red", width = 3, dash = "dash")
      ))
    )
})
```

## Activity 5: Calculate the Otsu threshold

```{r otsu-threshold, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
gli <- safe_gli(rgb[["Red"]], rgb[["Green"]], rgb[["Blue"]])
names(gli) <- "GLI"

otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
otsu_threshold

values <- terra::values(gli, mat = FALSE)
values <- values[is.finite(values)]
hist(values, breaks = 80, main = "GLI and Otsu Threshold", xlab = "GLI")
abline(v = otsu_threshold, col = "red", lwd = 3, lty = 2)
```

## Activity 6: Create the vegetation mask

```{r vegetation-mask, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
gli <- safe_gli(rgb[["Red"]], rgb[["Green"]], rgb[["Blue"]])
otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)

vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(gli > otsu_threshold, 1, 0)
names(vegetation_mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"

plot(vegetation_mask, col = c("grey85", "forestgreen"), main = "Binary Vegetation Mask")
```

---

## Activity 7: Mask RGB and GLI

```{r mask-rgb-gli, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
gli <- safe_gli(rgb[["Red"]], rgb[["Green"]], rgb[["Blue"]])
otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(gli > otsu_threshold, 1, 0)

vegetation_only_mask <- terra::ifel(vegetation_mask == 1, 1, NA)
vegetation_rgb <- rgb * vegetation_only_mask
vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(vegetation_mask == 1, gli, NA)
names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"

terra::plotRGB(
  vegetation_rgb,
  r = 1, g = 2, b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "Vegetation-Only RGB"
)

plot(vegetation_gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"), main = "Vegetation-Only GLI")
```

---

## Activity 8: Explore plot boundaries

This Leaflet map contains **vector polygons only**. No raster is sent to the browser.

```{r vector-map-ui, echo=FALSE}
leafletOutput("plot_map", height = "560px")
```

```{r vector-map-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
output$plot_map <- renderLeaflet({
  plots <- plots_raw

  if (!terra::same.crs(plots, "EPSG:4326")) {
    plots <- terra::project(plots, "EPSG:4326")
  }

  plot_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(plots)
  labels <- as.character(plot_sf[[plot_id_field]])

  leaflet::leaflet(options = leaflet::leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) |>
    leaflet::addProviderTiles(leaflet::providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") |>
    leaflet::addProviderTiles(leaflet::providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light map") |>
    leaflet::addPolygons(
      data = plot_sf,
      color = "#111827",
      weight = 2,
      opacity = 1,
      fillColor = "#2ca25f",
      fillOpacity = 0.15,
      label = labels,
      popup = paste0("<b>Plot:</b> ", labels),
      group = "Plot boundaries"
    ) |>
    leaflet::addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Satellite", "Light map"),
      overlayGroups = "Plot boundaries",
      options = leaflet::layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
})
```

---

## Activity 9: Extract plot-level traits

```{r extract-traits, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
gli <- safe_gli(rgb[["Red"]], rgb[["Green"]], rgb[["Blue"]])
otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(gli > otsu_threshold, 1, 0)
vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(vegetation_mask == 1, gli, NA)
names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"
plots <- align_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)

mean_result <- terra::extract(vegetation_gli, plots, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
sd_result <- terra::extract(vegetation_gli, plots, fun = sd, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
cover_result <- terra::extract(vegetation_mask, plots, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)

plot_level_traits <- data.frame(
  plot_id = as.data.frame(plots)[[plot_id_field]],
  mean_vegetation_gli = round(mean_result[, 2], 4),
  sd_vegetation_gli = round(sd_result[, 2], 4),
  canopy_cover_percent = round(100 * cover_result[, 2], 2)
)

plot_level_traits
```

### Interactive trait table and Plotly summary

```{r results-ui, echo=FALSE}
DTOutput("trait_table")
plotlyOutput("trait_chart", height = "450px")
downloadButton("download_traits", "Download Plot-Level Traits")
```

```{r results-server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
plot_traits <- reactive({
  obj <- analysis_objects()
  plots <- obj$plots
  mean_result <- terra::extract(obj$vegetation_gli, plots, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
  sd_result <- terra::extract(obj$vegetation_gli, plots, fun = sd, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
  cover_result <- terra::extract(obj$mask, plots, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, exact = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    plot_id = as.data.frame(plots)[[plot_id_field]],
    mean_vegetation_gli = round(mean_result[, 2], 4),
    sd_vegetation_gli = round(sd_result[, 2], 4),
    canopy_cover_percent = round(100 * cover_result[, 2], 2)
  )
})

output$trait_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(plot_traits(), rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10))
})

output$trait_chart <- renderPlotly({
  traits <- plot_traits()
  plotly::plot_ly(
    traits,
    x = ~reorder(as.character(plot_id), mean_vegetation_gli),
    y = ~mean_vegetation_gli,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = ~mean_vegetation_gli, colorscale = "Viridis")
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      title = "Mean Vegetation GLI by Plot",
      xaxis = list(title = "Plot ID", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis = list(title = "Mean vegetation GLI")
    )
})

output$download_traits <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() "plot_level_rgb_gli_traits.csv",
  content = function(file) write.csv(plot_traits(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```

## Workflow complete

The tutorial keeps meaningful interactivity while avoiding interactive raster rendering, which reduces browser memory use and package complexity.
